ASSURE is the first system that enables automatic recovery from unanticipated failures for server applications without application source code, without base operating system changes, and without application modification, by automatically identifying and testing rescue points that enable recovery from a larger set of failures than the application was designed to handle, and by automatically patching the application with the tested rescue point.
